newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber slightly higher on Tokyo rises.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber slightly higher on Tokyo rises.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were slightly higher in early trading on Tuesday following rises in Tokyo, traders said.
"Offer prices have improved a bit today after rises in Tokyo yesterday. We are hoping prices will stay at the same level for at least the rest of the day," said one trader in Jakarta.
"Offer prices in Medan have risen from 43.00 (U.S. cents/lb) to 43.50 for September shipment. Buyers can get rubber at that level if they want to buy," he said.
Tokyo rubber futures ended higher across the board on Monday on short-covering by private investors, on a perception that the recent fall has been too rapid, Japanese traders said.
Indonesian traders said they still paid attention to price movements in Thailand after the country floated the baht last Wednesday.
"Many traders are still talking about Thailand because of the cheaper prices out there. Today, buyers are expecting bullish sentiment because of the Tokyo factor," said another trader.
Traders said offer prices were quoted at 43.00 fob Palembang for September shipment, 42.75 fob Padang and Surabaya and 41.50 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
